name: sfx
title: Sfx
description: Onomatopoeia lettering: the SFX face (covers katakana) with a paper knockout, a tilt and a stepped pop when it appears. Variants solid (ink letters) and outline (paper letters, ink outline). Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass label to make it spoken. On a Page the four sizes follow the page width instead of the screen.

meta.tagline: Sound effects in heavy lettering, with a paper knockout.
meta.usage:
import { Sfx } from "@/components/manga/sfx"

<Sfx size="lg" rotate={-10}>ドン</Sfx>
<Sfx variant="outline" label="Silence">シーン</Sfx>

props.name: variant
props.description: Ink letters or outlined paper letters.

props.name: animated
props.description: Stepped pop on appear (off with reduced motion).

props.name: label
props.description: Spoken text; without it the SFX is aria-hidden.
